The Default Graph of a Term

Source: R/plot_core.R
default_plot.Rd

Returns the plot_type object that autoplot.StatmodFit() uses for a term when plot_type is not given. The method for modelterms7::model_term returns plot_effect(), and a class of term with a more informative graph has a method of its own.

Usage

default_plot(term, ...)

Arguments

term

A model term, an object inheriting from modelterms7::model_term.

...

Unused.

Value

An object inheriting from plot_type.

See also

plot_type, autoplot.StatmodFit()

Examples

default_plot(modelterms7::s(x))
#> <statmodels7::PlotEffect>
#>  @ label      : chr "plot_effect()"
#>  @ legend     : logi TRUE
#>  @ residuals  : logi TRUE
#>  @ binned     : NULL
#>  @ scale      : chr "link"
#>  @ at         : NULL
#>  @ rug        : logi TRUE
#>  @ level      : num 0.95
#>  @ vcov_type  : <statmodels7::BayesianVcov>
#>  .. @ name       : chr "bayesian"
#>  .. @ information: NULL
#>  @ information: <distributions7::ExpectedInfo>
#>  .. @ method: NULL
#>  @ n_grid     : num 200
